query:
UPDATE behavior_dimension d
           SET "order" = v.idx
           FROM (SELECT id, (ordinality - 1)::int AS idx
                 FROM unnest($3::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(id, ordinality)) AS v
           WHERE d.id = v.id
             AND d.matrix_id = $1
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM behavior_matrix m
                         WHERE m.id = $1 AND m.user_id = $2)
